BrochureContent.Content:
Set in the heart of Furbo, this spacious detached three-bedroom home with a self-contained one-bedroom annex offers the perfect blend of flexible living, privacy and an exceptional coastal lifestyle. Just a short distance from Furbo Beach and within easy reach of excellent local amenities, it is ideally suited to modern family living.

Inside, the home is bright, spacious and thoughtfully designed. The welcoming living room features a solid fuel stove and opens through patio doors onto a private south-facing patio, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.

The light-filled dual-aspect kitchen overlooks the generous rear garden, providing an ideal space for everyday family life and entertaining. A large utility room with external access and a ground-floor bathroom with shower add to the home's practicality.

Across the hall is the west-facing dining room with gas fire that can easily be converted into a fifth bedroom./playroom/office.The ground floor also includes two generous double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Upstairs, the spacious principal bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with walk-in wardrobes and a well-appointed ensuite.

Adjoining the main residence is a fully self-contained one-bedroom annex with its own open-plan kitchen and living area, together with an ensuite bedroom. Perfect for extended family, guests, remote working or potential rental income, this versatile space can also be seamlessly incorporated back into the main house if required.

Outside, mature gardens provide a private setting, while Furbo National School, Furbo GAA Club, local shops and Furbo beach are all within walking distance. Barna Village is just five minutes away, Galway City is approximately fifteen minutes by car, and the spectacular Connemara coastline is right on your doorstep.

Offering generous accommodation, excellent flexibility and a sought-after coastal location, this is a home that combines everyday comfort with an exceptional lifestyle.
